sam_sre: Scheduled maintenance: edge KV cache rebalance + prefix prune. Window: Tue 2026-04-06 03:00-04:00 UTC. Affects: us-east-1 and ap-northeast-1 edge racks.
sam_sre: Purpose: reduce long-tail evictions and even slot distribution. Plan: small canary in us-east-1a (5%) -> observe 15m -> ramp to 25/60/100 with stage gates. Purge removes prefixes >30d.
deploy_bot: Event created: 'edge-kv-prune-2026-04-06' scheduled by sam_sre.
oncall_bob: Acked. I'll monitor edge.kvcache.evictions, infer.p95, route.errors.
sam_sre: Quick ops notes: start canary: `POST /ops/route-shift {"policy":"kv-prune-hedge","percent":5}`. Rollback: set percent 0 and scale cronjob: `kubectl scale cronjob kv-prune -n infra --replicas=0`.
Triage triggers: if infer.p95 > baseline*1.2 for 10m or 5xx_rate spike -> rollback.
tess_prod: Product: prepare support blurb if Dedicated tenants in us-east report >10% p95 increase sustained 30m.
oncall_bob: I'll pre-create alerts and a watchlist. Who's running rewarm?
sam_sre: Kevin will run soft rewarm script to avoid a stampede. Add jitter and cap per-AZ QPS to 200.
oncall_bob: Got it. I'll post live updates in this thread during the window.
